title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks reused by the entity schemas. Open vocabularies are plain strings: consumers must render unknown values as text.

id.description: Opaque identifier. Never parse or build it.

extra.description: Free key value area for anything that fits nowhere else. Rendered as plain key value text.

source.description: Where a value was found. Page is 1 based; for Excel it is the sheet position. The quote exists only during review.

candidate.description: One possible value for a fact during review.

alternatives.description: Values that differ only by rounding, grouped into this candidate.

fact.description: One open profile fact. The UI never knows the label set in advance.

group.description: Free grouping label, for example Organschaft.

value.description: Any JSON value. Absent or null when missing.

type.description: Known: string, integer, number, boolean, date, enum, list, object. Unknown types render as text.

enumValues.description: Allowed values when type is enum.

code.description: Backend field id, for example B04. Opaque.

coreField.description: Optional. The company core field this fact fills on confirmation: name, legalForm, industry, customerNumber, contact.salutation, contact.name, contact.email, contact.phone. Unknown values are ignored.

reviewStatus.description: Known: confirmed, single_source, conflict, missing. Unknown values render as text.

reviewReason.description: Why the value needs review, for example OCR page.

reasoning.description: Extraction reasoning, shown only during review.

alternatives.description: Values that differ only by rounding from the shown value.
